notes: Graphiti 0.30.2 builds its range + fulltext indexes on Neo4j 5.26 Community (index types seen: FULLTEXT, LOOKUP, RANGE). The Neo4j driver also schedules build_indices_and_constraints() itself at construction, so an explicit call races it and logs harmless 'equivalent index already exists' errors. APOC is present in the spike image; Graphiti 0.30.2 core paths used here ran without needing it.
